buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used for the isotherm experiment

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used

process_id_field.description: Process identifier as specified in eLabFTW metadata

pump_speed.description: Pump speed used during loading and equilibration

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin in each well

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand

total_volume_ul.description: Total liquid volume per well used for loading

venting_time_s.description: Venting time per equilibration or loading step

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the isotherm (parsed from semicolon- or comma-separated values when numeric)

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles before measurement

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used in the isotherm (parsed from semicolon- or comma-separated values when numeric)

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength of the plate reader

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve for converting absorbance to concentration

salt_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the salt stock solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit of ligand concentrations (e.g. uM, mM)

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the ligand stock solution

equilibration_cycle_duration_s.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations in the plate

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations in the plate

analysis_status.description: Status of the plate reader loading isotherm analysis

analysis_message.description: Human-readable message about the analysis outcome

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when results were committed to the database

metadata.description: Key metadata extracted and reused from the analysis output

summary.description: Summary metrics from Langmuir fits across salt concentrations

num_salt_conditions.description: Number of salt conditions with fit parameters

q_max_mean.description: Mean q_max across salt conditions (excluding NaN)

q_max_std.description: Standard deviation of q_max across salt conditions

K_mean.description: Mean Langmuir binding constant K across salt conditions

K_std.description: Standard deviation of K across salt conditions

r2_mean.description: Mean coefficient of determination R^2 across salt conditions

data_files.description: Paths to main data output files from the analysis script

warnings.description: List of warnings propagated from the analysis script, if any
